create_WmtT2tTranslate: create a WmtT2tTranslate builder for German-to-English translation dataset from Tensor2Tensor
build_WmtT2tTranslate_config: build a WmtT2tTranslate builder config with German-English language pair and version 1.0.0
test_WmtT2tTranslate_train: test the WmtT2tTranslate dataset builder using the TRAIN split with europarl_v7, commoncrawl, and newscommentary_v13 subsets
test_WmtT2tTranslate_validation: test the WmtT2tTranslate dataset builder using the VALIDATION split with newstest2013 subset
test_WmtT2tTranslate_test: test the WmtT2tTranslate dataset builder using the TEST split with newstest2014 subset
